'''Danella Mathendrin''' was a noblewoman who founded the nation of [[Maredo]].

== History ==
Danella Mathendrin led the nobles who founded the nation of Maredo in {{fy|999}}.<ref name="comp">[[The Wheel of Time Companion]], Far Madding.</ref> Although not confirmed, it is likely that she became the first queen of Maredo.
